name: Slovakia
administering_agency: District office in the seat of the region (three-member commission), or a diplomatic mission

format.notes: A three-member commission checks command of Slovak, spoken and written, "and general knowledge of the Slovak Republic" while the applicant completes the questionnaire, in a way suited to their health, education and age.

exemptions.age: The check is adapted to the applicant’s age; several categories of applicant are excused by the Act.
exemptions.disability: The check is adapted to the applicant’s state of health.

unverified.exam_name: The Act gives it no name: it is the verification of "ovládanie slovenského jazyka", which the Act defines to include general knowledge of the Slovak Republic.

notes: Act 40/1993 as in force from 1 April 2022. This is a commission’s check rather than a standard test with published questions.
